title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Mon Nov 16)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Week 11 fallout

Week 11 was costly: a top-5 WR is done for the year, a 5⭐ freshman QB stepped in for the Vols, and three QBs are banged up heading into Week 12 🧵👇

🍊 TENNESSEE

🩹 Mike Matthews | WR | JR, 5⭐ | #5 WR: out for the season (knee) after getting hurt at Texas A&M (via On3, Fantrax)

George MacIntyre left with right knee discomfort. FR 5⭐ Faizon Brandon (#29 QB) took over, and his first pass was a TD to DaSaahn Brame.

🩹 QB INJURY WATCH

• Drew Mestemaker | Oklahoma State | JR | #4 QB: an early shoulder injury hindered him vs Texas Tech (via 247Sports)
• LaNorris Sellers | South Carolina | SR | #30 QB: ankle; Cutter Woods started at Arkansas (via On3)

Also:

🩹 Tayven Jackson | North Texas | #18 QB: feared season-ending (via Fantrax)
🩹 Nick Marsh | Indiana | JR | #16 WR: left vs USC (via On3)
🩹 Carson Hansen | Penn State | SR | #49 RB: exited vs Minnesota (via Fantrax)

Whose status are you watching? 👇
